decisions.reason: The scalar vertex gauge is valid for every full face prescription: adjacent-coordinate swaps give path independence, and scalar signs commute with every supplied marked right action. The original final clause referred to a mark without choosing one. It now explicitly applies when a component is marked away from saddle disks; unmarked sign existence remains unchanged. Checked the finite three-saddle cases against Putyra Proposition 4.10 and the sign construction against Proposition 5.1.

The original defining sentence placed Reidemeister moves between exceptional levels and required a Morse critical point at every exceptional level. A generic projected regular-height isotopy can have an R1/R2/R3 event without any surface-height critical point. The definition now distinguishes these isolated projection events from births, deaths and saddles, with planar isotopy between events; this agrees with the finite-movie supplier. The two-circle to one-circle saddle schematic has the correct component change.

F4 truthfully describes the proof of the cited general-position lemma, rather than claiming its Statement already grants relative tangle genericity. That proof prescribes independent third jets at up to six moving source points by degree-43 ambient polynomials and proves deleted-diagonal finiteness. Step 6.1 explicitly adapts those families with support off the protected arc and collars; projection separation excludes mixed exterior events, while the straight joining collars have a regular neighborhood. Multiplication by a cutoff positive on the active part preserves independent jets; the same codimension counts and local diagonal exclusions apply. Steps 1.1–5.1 supply the actual relative arc isotopy and Morse construction. Thus the claimed relative conclusion is proved locally, not inferred from the narrower closed-link statement.

Square compatibility alone leaves zero-composite face products unconstrained, whereas step 3.1 can compare only realizations of the same full face prescription. The standard odd tensor-product theorem now explicitly specifies those full input signs, matching its existing conclusion and proof contract. Checked the balanced right-module map in the reduced difference basis, the r1*sigma2 sign, the cochain sign on second-factor edges, all mixed-face products, the quantum shift -1, and the common mod-two multiplication. This is a sign-domain correction, not a proof of invariance for arbitrary square-compatible candidates.

F3 incorrectly credited the integral square-zero lemma with identifying the Lee associated-graded differential. The identification is already proved by the four basis operations and quantum shifts in step 1.1, so F3 now attributes only square-zero to that supplier and points to the local calculation. Checked the enhanced-label decomposition into Boolean cubes, their explicit contractions, canonical singleton basis, and the marked involution: it exchanges the two congruence lines with filtered degree -2 in both directions, forcing their gap to be two. The crossing schematic has clockwise ports 1,2,3,4 and correct black NE/SW sectors; its prose locator now points to step 1.2.

The rejected assertion is explicitly established in the cited lemma Proof 5.1. Its X_p involution has square one and filtered degree -2, exchanges the two nonzero congruence lines from step 4.1, and bounds each line level by the other minus two. Their levels differ by two modulo four, so the absolute gap is exactly two. The filtered direct sum shows the only nonzero-class levels are these two values. Thus F3 accurately cites an actual proved supplier conclusion, even though the supplier Statement advertises only equal canonical levels and distinct congruences. Finite filtration gives both extrema, and filtered diagram invariance under AC_omega makes the definition well-defined.

F7 is applied first with the same germ coordinates, radius r, epsilon and R, so its explicit formula produces literally the same exterior w(x) arc, cut points and flat spatial marked germ at both endpoints. These are exactly F8’s common compatible endpoint hypotheses. F8 Proof 4.1 then explicitly supplies the cited comparison: b_u=uR^2/conj(p), disk automorphisms f_u, their planar relative extension Phi_u, and one common image closing arc. The proof does not apply F8 to arbitrary unnormalized endpoints. Its relative center–tangent contraction and identity end coordinates are proved in steps 1.1–3.1 of F8. Checked the statewise mod-two maps, marked rank-one localization and full-face tensor-product uses; the clarified mark and sign hypotheses are met.

The positive-crossing smoothing claim was correct but A2 attributed it to interfaces that only define determinant signs and name A/B. Added the actual Kauffman source-chart dependency and a two-orientation local calculation: over (1,1) and under (-1,1) have positive determinant, so the incoming SW/SE ends are paired to outgoing NW/NE by the A=0 smoothing; simultaneous reversal gives the other positive case. The canonical cycle is then in degree zero with no incoming boundaries, and its unique all-X term has quantum degree n-k, giving s=n-k+1. The Statement and its strength are unchanged.

Step 1.2 explicitly proves the equivariance alleged to be missing: the local maps constructed in the invariance supplier use saddle maps, dots, coefficient projections/relabelings and scalar identity pivots. At an exterior marked point these commute with X_p by the displayed Frobenius identities; small-circle coefficient projections also commute with the exterior action. Thus all local equivalences intertwine the c component actions. Their 2^c distinct simultaneous eigenlines are exactly the canonical orientation classes, which an isomorphism cannot kill or mix. Step 2.1 tracks unique compatible component orientations across bands and excludes any disappearing closed partial component using connectedness. The two resulting nonzero output classes give an isomorphism, and forward/reverse filtered degree -2g yields the bound. F3 is not used as an unproved assertion of equivariance.

The foundations Statement is a summary, but its actual Proof 2.1 explicitly constructs integral marked odd and BN equivalences with common reductions, and Proof 4.1 constructs the paired concordance maps and localized BN equivalence. Its F4 directly names the movie-map supplier. The theorem additionally lists and cites these same suppliers in F5–F8; steps 4.1–6.1 use their common endpoint coordinates and full-face tensor products. Thus F3 summarizes proved arguments, not missing hypotheses. Checked finite-free tensor closure, the dual shift +2 with tensor shift -1, both evaluation/coevaluation maps and the distinct homotopies fg~1_D and gf~1_C, and the localized rank-one test. Consulted DLS Definitions 3.1–3.7, Proposition 3.4 and complete Theorem 3.8 proof; these support the same constructions, with the local geometric suppliers retaining their stronger trace qualifications.

The finite tau-threshold definition explicitly introduces no choice axiom and proves its minimum by the well-ordering principle. The original axiom_use therefore misattributed AC_omega to both invariant definitions. Corrected axiom_use and A1 to inherit countable choice from diagram-independent s and the actual joint Whitehead-value supplier. The exact knot and t=2 convention match both supplied interfaces; substituting s=2 and tau=0 gives 2 unequal to 2*0, so the counterexample proof and Statement are unchanged.
